comment: The petal container: an inert square frame. It has no health, no damage, and no knockback in either direction — collisions are still DETECTED against it (that's not switchable), but nothing comes of them. `density`/`speed`/`rangeMult` are 0 only because Entity multiplies them into derived stats; with knockback off, density is never read at all. `passive` disposition keeps it out of targeting entirely: it never seeks, and hostile mobs only hunt `allied` entities so nothing hunts it. `sizeScalesWithRarity: false` because a container's rarity describes the PETAL inside it, not the box — a legendary drop is a normal-sized box holding a legendary petal, not one four times the player's size.
